title: Linear Search Loop lacking Sentinel (Redundant Bounds Test)
pattern: A linear search loop that checks both the array index boundary (`i < count`) and the target element matching condition on every step.
why_bad: Wastes CPU cycles by executing a redundant branch instruction (`i < count`) on every element scan.
detection: Linear search loops executing over arrays with compound termination conditions.
counterexample: The array size is dynamic and cannot be padded, or the elements are checked out of bounds. `Context-dependent`.
fix: Append a temporary sentinel value (`test_value`) just past the search array end, simplifying the loop test to `item[i] != test_value`.
